binding_and_health.thread25_root_cause: Forked child binding lookup was scoped to child instance while inherited semantic bindings remained parent-owned; positive learner canonical keys could not resolve to child graph edges.

binding_and_health.thread76: Historical cause remains unresolved; corrected health classifier will surface the same binding/distribution/landing boundary immediately in future runs. No historical rerun or relabeling.
